title: A zero-mean case can conceal a bug
notes: 2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: A zero-mean case can conceal a bug. Define: Changing n to n+1 leaves a zero numerator unchanged. Walk through: [0,0,0] can pass the mean check; [79,80,81] cannot pass under the buggy denominator. Ask: What kind of testing lesson is this? Expected answer and boundary: Test discriminating inputs that separate plausible defects, not merely convenient examples. Visual purpose: show Sum=0 | Divide by n | Divide by n+1 | Same zero. Facilitation: ask students for a prediction before execution, locate the actual intermediate values, and distinguish observation from interpretation. Transition: connect this checked mechanism to the next beat; preserve the lab artifact where requested.
